package.description: Convert legacy Quattro Pro spreadsheets to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, or SQLite locally on Windows.

en-US.description: Convert legacy Quattro Pro spreadsheets to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, or SQLite locally on Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
Bulk-convert legacy Quattro Pro spreadsheets (.qpw, .wq1, .wq2, .wb1, .wb2, .wb3) to XLSX, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and SQLite locally on Windows.
SQLite output is one database with one table per sheet.
LibreOffice is bundled with the installer, so no additional software is required.
en-US.name: Quattro Pro Converter
